collection.name: Builder Bots AI
collection.description:
333 Builder Bots.

Each one is a fully modeled 3D character with its own guild, chassis, colorway and gear. Not a flat image. Every bot is a real GLB model you can rotate, zoom and inspect from any angle, right on the item page.

The model, the viewer and the artwork all live permanently on Arweave. The piece keeps working on its own, whether or not any marketplace does.

Each bot is activatable as an ERC-8004 trustless agent once minted and held.

Guilds run through the entire set, with traits covering chassis, primary color, headwear, eyewear, handheld, back accessory, visor lens, street gear and special features, across rarity tiers from Common to one of one.

Built by Chazz Gold., AutoMigo & CryptoNovo
